articles.title: How Camila Mendes Became a Real-Life Warrior for 'Masters of the Universe'
articles.summary: Camila Mendes didn't just act like Teela—she trained with swords and rifles to become her! The 'Riverdale' star reveals how tough workouts and weapon practice helped her play the captain of the Royal Guard in the new He-Man movie, in theaters June 5.

articles.title: Meet the Astronauts Who Spent 167 Days in Space!
articles.summary: NASA astronauts Zena Cardman and Mike Fincke, plus JAXA's Kimiya Yui, are sharing stories from their 167-day space mission. They traveled 71 million miles and did cool science experiments. Catch them live at NASA Headquarters on June 1!

articles.title: Tiny Chip Towers Could Make Your Devices Super Powerful!
articles.summary: Scientists found a way to stack silicon chips like a high-rise building, packing more power into less space. This 3D chip breakthrough could keep making computers faster and smarter, just like Moore's Law predicted, for years to come.
